## **Баги и стабильность** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Баги и стабильность.**
      5 свежих отзыв(ов) упоминают: баги и стабильность.
      Период отзывов: 14 мая 2026 г. - 28 сент. 2026 г.
      **Что это значит:** Пользователи упоминают краши или нестабильность. Это actionable только при всплеске или после обновления; иначе часто baseline-шум.

         **Примеры отзывов:**
            1. _bshwbdidn_, 16 июн. 2026 г., 1/5: "Ever since ABC bought out trainerize it’s been downhill from there They push the glitz and glam upgrades and AI tools (which quite frankly are of no real use for a non cookie cutter coaching service) But then have absolutely zero interest in making sure their platform actually works. Always glitched, always app crashes and never any true accountability I’ve been on multiple calls and email exchanges to be reassured that things would get better. It’s been over a year of this now and my patience is gone. I’ll be transferring my client base elsewhere and would not recommend this to any coach looking to keep their name in good standings with their client base."
            2. _Tatitai_, 17 июн. 2026 г., 3/5: "Out of nowhere this app crashes and you don’t know when it will be back. It’s a great app for tracking and training. Cross information between Hevy, My fitness pal, Health app from iOS, iFitness. It would be 5/5 if it didn’t crash so often."
            3. _3746482_, 12 июн. 2026 г., 3/5: "I enjoy using the app but it glitches SO MUCH. Super frustrating when I’m working out"
